AnimeBuild.auto_build: This builds franchises for anime series without one and rebuilds old ones (default true). Building only writes mappings; episodes whose mapping is not settled import through sonarr's numbering, and their conflicts show in Admin › Reviews.
AnimeBuild.refresh_interval: This is how old a franchise's build may get before it is rebuilt. Default 168h (7 days), minimum 24h. Rebuilds are spread over the interval; a franchise with a refresh held for review waits for the review.

ArrSource.api_key_env: This names the environment variable holding the instance's API key.
ArrSource.url: This is the instance base url, without /api/v3. Its host must be a LAN address (loopback, RFC 1918 or ULA), since every request carries the API key.
ArrSource.version: This is the version key the instance's titles and files map to. Several instances may map to one version; the import then reports titles whose files differ between them.

Art.interval: This is the time between scheduled runs. Default 6h, minimum 10m.
Art.per_run: This caps the titles one run fetches. Default 200.
Art.prewarm: This fetches each filled title's poster at this size into the image cache, so grids load at once. Default w342; "off" turns it off.

CacheEvidence.torbox_check: This asks TorBox, with our own key, whether the best releases of a search are cached.
CacheEvidence.ttl: This is how long a provider's answer that a release is cached is remembered, per release and provider. Default 24h, 1h to 7d.

Cardigann.definitions: This is the repository branch the catalog follows. Unset: the catalog is not fetched.
Cardigann.flaresolverr_url: This is a FlareSolverr-compatible service (trawl) that passes Cloudflare checks, e.g. http://trawl:8191. Its traffic must leave through the VPN; requests to it go through the gateway as the indexer's own.
Cardigann.prowlarr: This is a prowlarr instance on the LAN. Add indexer links its indexers as Torznab feeds, or moves them to native ones; it is only read (GET /api/v1/indexer).

CardigannDefinitions.branch: This selects the repository branch. Default master.
CardigannDefinitions.refresh: This is how often the branch is checked. Default 24h, at least 1h.
CardigannDefinitions.repo: This is owner/repository on GitHub. Default prowlarr/indexers.

CardigannProwlarr.api_key_env: This names the environment variable holding the prowlarr API key.
CardigannProwlarr.url: This is the prowlarr server endpoint.

Client.callback_view: This is the view decypharr calls back (decypharr only).
Client.category: This is the download category Theatarr's adds go under; required for an add_via: client version. decypharr keys its arr settings on it: one client entry per view flavour.
Client.import_from: This is where a finished download is imported from: mount (the default: its release folder on Theatarr's debrid mount) or download_folder (the client's folder of symlinks into the mount).
Client.kind: This selects decypharr (a debrid client: it calls a view back, and takes the grabs of versions with add_via: client) or qbittorrent (a seedbox client: accepted, but nothing sends grabs to it yet).
Client.local_path: This is where Theatarr sees the client's remote_path.
Client.password_env: This names the environment variable holding the client password.
Client.remote_path: This and local_path map the client's paths to Theatarr's (an arr's remote path mapping): a content_path under remote_path is read under local_path. Both or neither, absolute.
Client.url: This is the download client endpoint.
Client.username_env: This and password_env name environment variables with the client's login. decypharr reads them as an arr's: the username is the callback view's url, the password a Theatarr key for it (any login works without its use_auth).

Egress.check_url: This is an IP-echo endpoint. It answers the caller's address as plain text, or as JSON with an "ip" field. Its host is allowlisted automatically.
Egress.interval: This is the time between checks. Default 2m.
Egress.max_age: This is how old the last good check may be before guarded requests are refused. Default 3 × interval.
Egress.require_vpn_for: This lists the classes that need a good check: indexers, providers, metadata. Omitted defaults to indexers; an explicit empty list monitors without refusing requests.
Egress.vpn_cidrs: This lists the allowed VPN exit address ranges.
Egress.vpn_ips: This and vpn_cidrs are the expected exit addresses. At least one entry is required.

ImagesConfig.dir: This is the cache directory, absolute. Default: images next to the database (/data/images in the container).
ImagesConfig.max_bytes: This caps the cache; the least recently used files go first. Default 2GiB, minimum 16MiB.
ImagesConfig.original: This allows the "original" size (full-resolution files, often several MB). Default false.

Import.arr: This maps an arr instance name (radarr_4k_debrid) to its source settings.

Library.dangling: This configures the read-only report of dangling links into the mount.
Library.enabled: This turns on filesystem writes and plex calls. Default false; with database settings it is derived from Pause.
Library.mount: This is where zurg is read.
Library.plex: This is the plex server scanned after a change. Optional.
Library.relink_interval: This is how often theatarr serve looks for dangling links and repoints them. Default 1h, minimum 10m.
Library.sample: This tunes the sample and fake guard.
Library.trash: This is where replaced links are moved aside (upgrades, relinks). Required once Pause is off.
Library.versions: This lists, per version key, where the library may write and which plex section shows it. A version not listed here never gets a write.

LibraryDangling.interval: This is the time between reports in theatarr serve (one at start). Default 6h, minimum 10m.
LibraryDangling.roots: This lists folders walked besides the version roots, read-only: the libraries the arrs still own and decypharr's downloads (for example /media and /downloads).

LibraryDecypharr.api_token_env: This names the environment variable holding decypharr's API token. Needed when decypharr asks for a login.
LibraryDecypharr.budget: This names a budget for requests to decypharr. Optional.
LibraryDecypharr.direct: This reads files from decypharr over the network, with no mount folder in Theatarr. Set the library link destination to where the media server sees decypharr's files. A read can make decypharr replace a Real-Debrid torrent. Default false.
LibraryDecypharr.interval: This is the longest decypharr's list of torrents is reused before it is read again. Default 1m, 10s to 1h.
LibraryDecypharr.password_env: This names the environment variable holding the WebDAV password.
LibraryDecypharr.url: This is decypharr's address, e.g. http://decypharr:8282, with its base path when decypharr has one.
LibraryDecypharr.username_env: This names the environment variable holding the WebDAV user name. Needed only when decypharr asks for a login on WebDAV.

LibraryMount.all_dir: This is the name of the folder directly under the mount that holds every release: a folder name, not a path (zurg and mounts laid out like it call it __all__). Default __all__.
LibraryMount.decypharr: This sets decypharr as the debrid mount in place of zurg. Reading a file through decypharr, playback included, can make it replace a Real-Debrid torrent with a new copy. Over this connection Theatarr only reads. Off when unset.
LibraryMount.link_path: This is the mount as written into symlinks: the absolute path at which plex (or another player) sees the mount. Leave it empty when that is the mount folder itself: an empty value uses the mount folder.
LibraryMount.path: This is where this service sees the mount, e.g. /mnt/debrid. Required once Pause is off.
LibraryMount.poll_interval: This is how often a waiting import looks again. Default 20s, minimum 5s.
LibraryMount.rclone_rc: This is the mount's rclone remote control (rclone rc): the now playing page reads core/stats and vfs/stats (docs/design/now-playing.md); forget_release_root lets an import clear one cached listing. Optional.
LibraryMount.stat_timeout: This bounds the health sentinel's stat; a hang or ENOTCONN pauses imports and sweeps. Default 5s.
LibraryMount.wait_timeout: This is how long an import waits for the release to appear before it alerts (it keeps waiting; no re-grab). Default 6m.
LibraryMount.zurg_api: This is zurg's base url (e.g. http://zurg:9999), read-only: GET /debug/torrents, /api/library/entry and /torrents/repair/status only.
LibraryMount.zurg_api_budget: This names a budget for zurg_api requests. Optional.
LibraryMount.zurg_api_interval: This is the longest an answer of zurg_api is reused: the torrent listing and the repair state are fetched at most once per interval, when a pass needs them. Default 1m, 10s to 1h.
LibraryMount.zurg_api_repair_grace: This bounds how long a running repair keeps dangling links from being marked dead: past it the sweep marks them as it would without the API. Default 2h, 10m to 24h.
LibraryMount.zurg_log: This is zurg's log (read-only): an absolute file path, or the http(s) url of zurg's /logs endpoint when the file is on another host.
LibraryMount.zurg_log_budget: This names a budget for the fetches of a url zurg_log. Optional.
LibraryMount.zurg_log_interval: This is how often a url zurg_log is fetched (each fetch returns the whole current log). Default 15s, 5s to 10m. A file is followed every 2s whatever this says.

LibraryProbe.max_bytes: This limits how many bytes are read per file. Default 16 MiB, 1 to 256 MiB.

LibrarySample.min_runtime_ratio: This rejects a file shorter than this share of the title's (or episode's) known runtime. Default 0.5; 0 < x <= 1.
LibrarySample.mislabel: This refuses a file whose probe plainly contradicts its Remux or 2160p label (an x264/x265 CRF encode named Remux, 1080-line video named 2160p). Default true.
LibrarySample.resolution: This rejects a file whose probed resolution is two or more steps under the release's (a 2160p release holding a 720p file). Default true.

LibraryTrash.dir: This is absolute, outside every library root (plex must not scan it) and outside the mount.
LibraryTrash.keep_days: This is the number of days before a moved-aside link is removed for good (the link only; debrid content is never touched). Default 30.

LibraryVersion.plex_section: This is the plex library section id that shows this version's root. 0: no scans.
LibraryVersion.roots: This lists the only directories this version may write under. versions[key].library must be one of them or under one.

Lists.interval: This is the time between refreshes. Default 24h, like Radarr.

Metadata.anime: This schedules the automatic anime franchise builds (animebuild.go).
Metadata.lists: This schedules Radarr collections and TMDb import lists.
Metadata.overrides_dir: This points at external data. Legacy relative values resolve beneath the policy base.
Metadata.series: This schedules the series metadata refresh (seriesmeta.go).
Metadata.sources: This lists metadata services by name.

MetadataSource.api_key_env: This names the environment variable holding the service API key.
MetadataSource.budget: This names the request budget for this service.
MetadataSource.url: This is the metadata service endpoint.

Notify.allow_hosts: This lists the hosts (host or host:port) an installed notification may target. Each joins the gateway's allowlist. Empty: installed notifications are stored but never sent.
Notify.budget: This names the budget every webhook request takes a token from (optional).
Notify.digest_at: This is the local time (HH:MM, the container's TZ) the daily digest goes to Discord and ntfy targets. Default 09:00.
Notify.enabled: This sends notifications. Off (the default): events are recorded, nothing is sent.
Notify.poll: This is how often the notifier looks for new events and due deliveries. Default 15s, 1s to 10m.
Notify.retries: This is how many times a failed delivery is retried. Default 5, 0 to 20.
Notify.targets: This lists webhook targets defined in the policy, by key.

NotifyTarget.auth_header_env: This names an environment variable holding the Authorization header value, when the target needs one.
NotifyTarget.events: This limits what this target is sent to the events chosen. Empty: all.
NotifyTarget.format: This is the message format: empty for the payloads above, discord for a Discord channel webhook, or ntfy. For ntfy the url is the server address followed by the topic, and an access token goes in the Authorization header.
NotifyTarget.native: This sends Theatarr's own per-version events (JSON, eventType theatarr.*).
NotifyTarget.url: This is where payloads are POSTed. Its host joins the gateway's allowlist.
NotifyTarget.versions: This limits native events to these versions. Empty: all.
NotifyTarget.views: This lists the arr views (keys of views, or v/<version>) whose arr-shaped payloads it gets.
NotifyTarget.warnings: This also sends health warnings, such as a mount that stopped answering, to this message target (format discord or ntfy). Errors are always sent; notices never are. Default false.

Playlists.enabled: This allows playlist writes in plex, together with library.enabled. Default false.
Playlists.franchises: This limits the sync to these slugs; empty: every built franchise.
Playlists.interval: This is how often theatarr serve syncs. Default 6h, minimum 1h.
Playlists.name: This is the playlist title; {franchise} and {order} are replaced. Default "{franchise} ({order})".
Playlists.orders: This lists the order kinds that get a playlist: release, watch, story. Default [watch, story].
Playlists.routes: This gives each alternate route of the watch order (Fate's routes) its own playlist. Default true.
Playlists.skip_optional: This leaves out optional rows (recaps, side stories, shorts). Default false.

Plex.budget: This names a budget for plex calls. Optional.
Plex.debounce: This coalesces scans of one folder. Default 30s.
Plex.now_playing: This follows plex's sessions for the now playing page (docs/design/now-playing.md). It only reads, so it does not need library.enabled. Default true.
Plex.prewarm: This reads the head of the next episode of a show being watched through the mount, about a minute into an episode, and raises an error inbox item when that episode is missing or unreadable; past half of the episode it reads the next one…
Plex.prewarm_max_size: This limits whole-file preloading; larger episodes get only a header check. Default 20GB.
Plex.prewarm_rate: This caps the pre-warm's whole-file read of the next episode, in bytes per second (25MB: 25 MB/s), so it never starves a live stream. Default 25MB.
Plex.token_env: This names the environment variable holding the plex token.
Plex.url: This is the plex server endpoint.

ProviderSync.interval: This is the time between syncs. Default 6h, minimum 15m.

RcloneRC.budget: This names a budget for rc calls. Optional.
RcloneRC.forget_release_root: This clears rclone's cache of the release root (vfs/forget; its subfolders and parent too) when zurg_api lists a torrent the mount does not show yet, at most every 3s. Default false.
RcloneRC.password_env: This names the environment variable holding the rclone remote control password.
RcloneRC.url: This is the rc base url, e.g. http://rclone:5572.
RcloneRC.username_env: This and password_env name the basic auth credentials (--rc-user, --rc-pass). Optional.

Router.alldebrid_delete_uncached: This lets "Only add cached releases" delete an uncached AllDebrid add the router believes is its own. Default false: the add is kept, it finishes downloading on AllDebrid, and the next provider is tried.
Router.cache_evidence: This is what the router and the release views know about which providers hold a release cached.
Router.cached_grace: This is how long the router waits before reading a fresh Real-Debrid or AllDebrid add again when the first read shows it still converting or downloading (one re-read; on Real-Debrid also after selecting files), before it calls the add…
Router.cached_only: This skips a provider where a release is known to be uncached (an earlier refusal, a cache check) and asks TorBox to add only if cached.
Router.downloading_timeout: This fails a download in state downloading whose provider progress has not risen for this long (a dead swarm, a magnet that never leaves the provider's queue): its hash is blocklisted for the version, our own Real-Debrid add is deleted…
Router.enabled: This lets the router write to debrid providers (add a magnet, select files). With database settings it is derived from Pause (true when Pause is off). False: every version is dry-run only, whatever its mode.
Router.max_candidates: This caps how many accepted releases of one search are tried, best first. Default 5, 1 to 50.
Router.miss_ttl: This is how long a release missed on every provider stays a miss. Default 6h, 10m to 7d.
Router.poll_interval: This is how often added downloads are read back from their provider. Default 1m, 15s to 1h.
Router.ready_timeout: This fails a download still ready this long after ready_at, blocklists it and searches again. Default 6h, 1m to 7d. No torrent is deleted on the provider.
Router.stalled_after: This fails a download still in state added (accepted, not ready, nothing fetched yet) this long after its add, as stalled (decypharr's remove_stalled_after): its hash is blocklisted for the version, our own Real-Debrid add is deleted,…
Router.trackers: This lists public tracker announce URLs added to every debrid magnet. Default none: the magnet is bare. Each must be udp, http or https with no credentials, no query and a path of "" or /announce.
Router.wanted: This is the search loop for the active versions' missing and cutoff-unmet titles and episodes.

SeriesMeta.enabled: This turns the refresh on; default true when a tvdb or tmdb source is configured.
SeriesMeta.interval: This is the time between due-series sweeps. Default 1h, minimum 10m. Which series are due follows sonarr's ShouldRefreshSeries (continuing every 12h, ended monthly).
SeriesMeta.per_run: This caps the series one sweep refreshes. Default 50.

Shadow.rss: This turns the shadow.rss job on or off. Default on.
Shadow.rss_interval: This is how often the shadow.rss job reads the rss feeds of the Live libraries' indexers. Default 15m, the arrs' default rss sync interval; minimum 10m.

TorBoxCheck.enabled: This turns it on. Default true; it does nothing without a TorBox provider whose key is set.
TorBoxCheck.per_hour: This caps checkcached requests in any hour. Default 60, 1 to 1000.
TorBoxCheck.top: This is how many hashes of one search are checked, best first. Default 10, 1 to 100.

TorrentBackup.every: This is the interval of scheduled backups; 0 (the default) is off. Minimum 1h.
TorrentBackup.keep: This is how many backups are kept (scheduled, by hand and before a delete alike); those from the last week are kept besides. Default 30.

Torrents.backup: This schedules backups of the provider torrent lists. Off unless backup.every is set.
Torrents.scan_roots: This lists library roots other tools manage. The usage check walks them for symlinks into the debrid mount (library.mount), reading only the link targets, never the mount, so a torrent such a library uses is not offered as unused.

UI.images: This configures the image cache on disk.

Wanted.again_after: This is how long an item waits before it is searched again. Default 24h, 1h to 30d.
Wanted.cutoff_unmet: This chooses automatic upgrade searches: quality, score or off.
Wanted.enabled: This turns the loop on. Default: on when some library is active, off otherwise.
Wanted.interval: This is the time between rounds. Default 15m, 5m to 24h.
Wanted.missing: This searches items with no file (default true). Which items with a file are searched for an upgrade is the upgrade search target below.
Wanted.per_hour: This caps the loop's searches (one title, season or episode each) in any hour. Default 10, 1 to 200.
Wanted.retry_new: This searches again 1, 2, 4 and 8 hours (and so on) after an automatic search for a missing episode or film that came out in the last 7 days finds nothing, instead of a day later. Each retry counts against the hourly limit.
